SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity"::INTEGER >= 200
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');
2:

    "id",
    "name" AS "event_space_name",
    "event_space" AS "type",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity" = '200'
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');
4:
SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'cafe'
    AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" != 'cafe'
    OR r."food_service" IS NULL;

109:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    string_agg(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems_list
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name"
ORDER BY
    its."name";
110:
SELECT
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active",
    its."name" AS "it_specialist_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
CROSS JOIN
    "systems" s
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON itss."it_specialist_id" = its."id"
    AND itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
WHERE
    itss."it_specialist_id" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    its."name",
    s."system_name";
111:
SELECT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id";
112:
WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM
        "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i

261:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
ORDER BY
    j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
263:
SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software engineer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."description") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."description") LIKE '%software engineer%';
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS position_title,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title,
    j."description" AS position_description,
    STRING_AGG(rs."skillname", ', ' ORDER BY rs."skillname") AS required_skills,
    STRING_AGG(er."degreelevel" || ' in ' || er."fieldofstudy", ', ' ORDER BY er."degreelevel") AS education_requirements
FROM
    "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN
    "jobskills" js ON j."jobid" = js."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "requiredskills" rs ON js."skillid" = rs."skillid"
LEFT JOIN
    "jobeducation" je ON j."jobid" = je."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "educationrequirements" er ON je."requirementid" = er."requirementid"
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs" WHERE "salary" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY
    j."jobid", j."minimum_years", j."preferred_years", j."jobtitle", j."description";
